notes.title: Demo and Kickstarter release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Demo and Kickstarter released![/h1]

Two weeks ago we launched the demo of A Trail of Ooze and the feedback has been absolutely amazing and so rewarding! Hearing what players think and getting feedback on the gameplay is invaluable to us. 
We have already used that feedback and made some minor bug patches and performance updates.

We hope you continue playing and let us know if you find that random Easter egg!
If you want to give us feedback we have a [url=discord.gg/AvU9NEsNeG]discord channel [/url]for this. Or just drop by to say hi! ːsteamhappyː


[h1]Kickstarter Oct 26 - Nov 25[/h1]
Today the Kickstarter campaign for A Trail of Ooze went live and we are currently about 25% backed!
Help us spread the word to raise some funds towards developing the full game!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/insantostudios/a-trail-of-ooze/]Back it here![/url]ːsteamthisː
